login.title: Sign in to the SaaS console
login.description: Use your production account to access the console. Credentials are stored by the backend in HttpOnly cookies; the frontend never stores access tokens.
login.localAccountCommand: go run . user-password-create --email admin@example.com --password '0123456789abcde' --name Admin --email-verified true
login.lockedOutMessage: Account temporarily locked. Try again in {time}.

oauth.noProviders: No social login providers are enabled.

errors.provider_disabled: This social login provider is not enabled.
errors.oauth_provider_disabled: This social login provider is not enabled.
errors.oauth_provider_invalid: This social login provider is not supported.
errors.oauth_state_invalid: Social login session expired. Please try again.
errors.oauth_state_missing: Social login session expired. Please try again.
errors.oauth_redirect_invalid: The requested return path is invalid.
errors.oauth_code_missing: The provider did not return an authorization code.
errors.oauth_verified_email_missing: The provider did not return a verified email address.
errors.oauth_email_missing: The provider did not return an email address.
errors.oauth_auth_id_missing: The provider did not return a stable account identifier.
errors.oauth_token_exchange_failed: The provider token exchange failed. Please try again.
errors.oauth_github_profile_failed: GitHub profile lookup failed. Please try again.
errors.oauth_github_email_failed: GitHub email lookup failed. Please try again.
errors.oauth_google_profile_failed: Google profile lookup failed. Please try again.
errors.oauth_failed: Social login failed. Please try again.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Enter the email address associated with your account and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.successMessage: If an account exists for that email, you will receive a password reset link shortly.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.successMessage: Your password has been reset. Please sign in with your new password.
resetPassword.invalidToken: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.

register.title: Register for the SaaS console
register.description: After you create a production account, the system prepares a default organization. If this is the first registration, the backend grants platform administrator access for initialization.
register.registrationDisabledHint: If public registration is disabled on the backend, enable auth.password.registrationEnabled in configuration or create an account with the administrator CLI. Platform administrator access is granted only by the backend when the user table is empty.
register.verificationSent: Registration successful! Please check your email and verify your address.

verifyEmail.title: Email Verification
verifyEmail.success: Email verified successfully! Redirecting to login...
verifyEmail.error: Verification failed. The link may be expired or already used.

totp.title: Two-Factor Authentication
totp.description: Add an extra layer of security to your account with a one-time code from an authenticator app.

verify.title: Two-Factor Authentication
verify.description: Enter the code from your authenticator app

errors.tokenExpired: Your verification session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please try again later.

setup.title: Set Up Two-Factor Authentication
setup.description: Confirm your password, scan the QR code, then verify a 6-digit code to turn on 2FA.
setup.step1Description: Scan this QR code with Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, or another TOTP app.
setup.step2Description: Enter the 6-digit code from your app to confirm the setup works.

backupCodes.title: Save Your Backup Codes
backupCodes.description: Store these codes in a safe place. Each code can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator app.
backupCodes.savedConfirmation: I have saved my backup codes in a secure location
backupCodes.remainingWarning: You have {count} backup code(s) remaining. Consider regenerating backup codes soon.

status.disabled: Two-factor authentication is not set up
status.disabledDescription: Set up an authenticator app so password login also requires a one-time code.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Review browsers and devices currently signed in to your account. Revoke sessions you no longer recognize.
sessions.emptyDescription: Sign in again to create a browser session.
sessions.currentHint: Use sign out to end this session.
sessions.confirmRevoke: Revoke this session? The device will need to sign in again.
sessions.confirmRevokeOthers: Revoke all other sessions? Other devices will need to sign in again.
sessions.privacyNote: IP addresses are masked before display. Session tokens and CSRF hashes are never returned to the browser.
